answer: The shale assignment is published and willow records each panel. The grading quorum of 4 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an copycat cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Shards are assigned from the nadir graph, as a result cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 2050 identities would post 4324 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
